title: cert.rs validate_chain dead_code suppress hides that verify() does not call it
description: cert.rs line 42 has #[allow(dead_code)] on validate_chain() with the comment 'used by verify() once that function is implemented'. However verify.rs does call validate_chain() (verify.rs line 204). The allow(dead_code) is stale — validate_chain IS called. The stale attribute misleads a future contributor into thinking chain validation is not wired up yet, which could lead them to incorrectly 'fix' it by adding a second call or replacing the existing one. It should be removed.
